task: independent primary-source review of all existing same-ID context proposals
scope: Every profile listed in context-edits/NUM/context-index.json (14, not 13); no drafts/maps/context proposals edited in this independent review.

contextIndexHashMismatches.noteJa: context-index.jsonのprofileSHA256が現在の14 proposalに一致しないため、判定は下記currentFileSHA256/current profile hashの現物に対するもの。

findingsJa: NUM1:20は「ルベン、イスラエルの長子」と記すため、父祖イスラエルの個人用法は本文から支持される。集団用法と分ける提案は正しい。summary/identityNoteの「集団名ではなく」「同ID」「既存の集団base」は内部用語なので本文に即した文へ改める。現map1:20にはperson:israel_682がない。部族/民のIsrael集団リンクに加え、父祖個人IDをdirect追加するmap修正案を出すべき。Wiki未検索。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

wikipediaIndependentAudit.basis: 日本語記事の族長ヤコブ。本文で別名イスラエルと明記され、創世記32章の改名箇所も説明する。固定NUM 1:20の「イスラエルの長子」に関係する同じ聖書上の人物。英語版より日本語版を優先。
wikipediaIndependentAudit.recommendation: Suitable identity link for the personal context; do not use the Israelites article for this person. The article discusses later family events, which are beyond NUM 1:20.
wikipediaIndependentAudit.englishAlternativeBasis: same textual figure; article is explicitly about biblical patriarch Jacob and identifies Israel as his alternate name. It does not establish independent historicity.

findingsJa: NUM3:17はゲルション、コハト、メラリをレビの子として明記。16:1と26:59も父祖レビを個人として名指すため、3座標の個人variantは合う。1–2章や3章のレビ人/レビ族の広い集団用法は別のcollective profileに残る。summary/identityNoteの「profile/base」は実装用語なので、本文の3:17の系譜へ置換。Wiki未検索。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.
The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

facts.textJa: 民数記16:1では、コラの系譜にレビが父祖として記される。
民数記26:59はヨケベドをレビの娘とし、エジプトでレビに生まれたと記す。

wikipediaIndependentAudit.basis: 日本語記事「レビ」はヤコブの三男と明記し、ゲルション・ケハテ・メラリの父として記載。レビ族記事ではなく個人記事。記事冒頭に出典不足テンプレートあり。
wikipediaIndependentAudit.recommendation: Suitable person link. The page also presents post-Torah traditions and later descendants; keep those claims out of the context profile.
wikipediaIndependentAudit.englishAlternativeBasis: Exact individual fit, but Japanese page flags insufficient sourcing. English Levi page is a better-sourced alternative if source quality is prioritized.

findingsJa: 初出NUM3:18はリブニとシムイをゲルションの子として列挙するだけ。subtitle/historyの「幕屋管理・運搬」は3:25–26以降の情報を knownBy3:18 へ先取りする。これらは3:25等にfactとしてゲートされているが、常時表示欄にも残るため同内容を削り、3:18で分かる系譜的な集団名に限定する。summary/identityNoteの「context」「既存base」も内部用語。passagesの集団座標は3:17個人を除いて本文用法と合う。Wiki=nullは未検索。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.
Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.
The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.
“Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;
you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
“This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:
they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.

At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.
This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,
from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,
even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.
These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD.
He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.
The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

facts.textJa: ゲルションの家族はリブニ人、シムイ人として数えられる。
ゲルションの子らには会見の天幕の幕・覆いなどの管理が割り当てられる。
ゲルションの子らの奉仕はアロンの子イタマルの管理下に置かれる。
モーセはゲルションの子らに荷車二台と牛四頭を与える。
幕屋の撤収時、ゲルションの子らはメラリの子らとともに幕屋を運んで進む。
レビ人の氏族人口調査にゲルション人が記される。

wikipediaIndependentAudit.basis: The article is specifically about the Gershonites as a Levite division, names the Libnites and Shimeites, and distinguishes them from Gershon and Moses’ Gershom.
wikipediaIndependentAudit.recommendation: Suitable group article. Its lead and later paragraphs include duties and cities beyond NUM 3:18; do not present those as known at the context profile’s first verse.

findingsJa: NUM3:19はコハトの子らの家族を挙げる初出で集団variantを支持する。mapのNUM3:30（コハト族の家族の長）にも集団IDがあり、提案passages/sourceが欠落しているため追記要。NUM26:58は「コハトはアムラムの父となった」と族祖個人を明示し、集団profileからは除外し個人用法として既存IDを別contextで検討する。NUM3:17/16:1も個人用法。4:5–14の記載は本文ではアロンと子らが聖所品を覆う作業で、コハトの子らの搬送は4:15。集団profileが担当する作業と範囲を狭めるか、これら節をpassagesから外すべき。summary/identityNoteのprofile文言も内部用語。Wiki未検索。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.
According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.
The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.
The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.
“Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
“This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.
When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,
put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.
“On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.
They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
“They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.
They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.
“On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.
“They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.
“They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

“When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

“The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”
The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
“Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;
but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;
but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”
from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.
Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.
These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.
The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.
These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

facts.textJa: コハト族の家系としてアムラム人、イツハル人、ヘブロン人、ウジエル人が挙げられる。
コハトの家族は幕屋の南側に宿営する。
コハトの子らには会見の天幕の最も聖なる物に関わる奉仕が定められる。
アロンと子らが聖所の品を覆った後、コハトの子らがそれを担う。
聖所の奉仕を担うため荷車は与えられず、肩で運ぶ。
レビ人の氏族人口調査にコハト人が記される。
アロンと子らは、コハトの氏族が聖所に近づいても死なないように守る責任を担うと指示される。
コハトの家族から会見の天幕で働く者として数えられた人数が記される。
コハト人は聖所を担い、他の者が到着前に幕屋を組み立てる。

wikipediaIndependentAudit.basis: The article is specifically about the Kohathites as a Levite division and names their claimed eponymous ancestor Kohath, distinct from the individual Kohath/Kehath article.
wikipediaIndependentAudit.recommendation: Suitable group article, but it exposes later sanctuary duties and Joshua-era city information; avoid treating these as known at NUM 3:19.

findingsJa: NUM3:20の初出はメラリの子らの家族名（マフリ・ムシ）を挙げる。subtitle/roleの幕屋部材管理・運搬は3:36–37以降の情報をknownBy3:20で先取りし、後続factと重複。初出欄を氏族系譜に限定し、奉仕は各factで遅くゲートする。個人メラリNUM3:17を集団passagesから外す点は適切。summary/identityNoteもcontext/baseの内部語を含む。Wiki未検索。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.
Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.
The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,
the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.
“As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;
you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.
This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.
This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”
Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,
from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,
even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.
These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.
He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

facts.textJa: メラリの家族はマフリ人とムシ人として示される。
メラリの氏族の宿営位置は幕屋の北側とされる。
幕屋の板、横木、柱、台座などがメラリの子らの担当に割り当てられる。
メラリの子らの奉仕内容が会見の天幕の管理として記される。
モーセはメラリの子らに荷車四台と牛八頭を与える。
幕屋の撤収時、メラリの子らはゲルションの子らとともに幕屋を運んで進む。
レビ人の氏族人口調査にメラリ人が記される。

wikipediaIndependentAudit.basis: The page is specifically about the Merarites as a Levite division and describes their claimed descent from Merari.
wikipediaIndependentAudit.recommendation: Suitable group article. Its later duty and city descriptions go beyond NUM 3:20 and should not leak into early context.

findingsJa: NUM26:8の「エリアブ、パルの子」が個人を直接示す。26:5のパル氏族は直前の集団用法なので個人passagesから外す判断は適切。summary/identityNoteに「ここでは/別に/集団base/profile」の実装説明があり、読者用には26:8の系譜をそのまま述べる形がよい。Wiki未検索。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
The son of Pallu: Eliab.

wikipediaIndependentAudit.basis: The list entry gives “Phallu or Pallu” and identifies the figure as Reuben’s son, citing Genesis 46:9, Exodus 6:14, and Numbers 26:5; that matches NUM 26:8’s named ancestor.
wikipediaIndependentAudit.recommendation: Suitable fragment link to the exact entry; confirm fragment handling in app URL validation before integration.

findingsJa: NUM26:45本文はベリアの子らとしてヘベルとマルキエルを列挙し、個人の系譜用法を支える。26:44のベリア人/氏族は直前の集団用法であり、個人context passage 26:45だけにする区別は適切。summary・identityNoteの「context」「既存集団base」は実装者向けで、読者用欄から除くか26:44–45の具体的な対照説明へ書き換える。Wiki=nullは未調査で、適合なしを意味しない。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.
Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

wikipediaIndependentAudit.basis: The list says Beriah names four biblical individuals. Its first entry is an Asher son and father of Heber and Malchiel, matching this candidate’s NUM 26:45 genealogy; the other three are different people.
wikipediaIndependentAudit.recommendation: Suitable only with the heading fragment and a note that it points to the first of four same-name figures; do not treat the whole list entry as uniquely disambiguated without the verse-specific note.

findingsJa: NUM26:33はツェロフハドをヘフェルの子と明記し、27:1の系譜も個人祖先用法を支える。26:32「ヘフェル氏族」は別集団用法で個人passagesから外すのが適切。summaryの「ここでは...区別」は編集説明なので読者用の26:33の系譜記述へ短縮。identityNoteも26:33本文の具体的説明にする。Wiki未検索。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

facts.textJa: 27:1はツェロフハドの系譜をヘフェル、ギレアド、マキル、マナセへとたどる。

wikipediaIndependentAudit.basis: The entry explicitly identifies Hepher as a son of Manasseh and cites Numbers 26:32 and Joshua 17:2, matching this candidate’s genealogical person rather than the place-name Hepher.
wikipediaIndependentAudit.recommendation: Suitable fragment link to the person entry; the page also points readers to a separate place-name entry, so preserve person/place distinction.

findingsJa: NUM26:29はマキルがギレアデの父となった系譜、26:30は「ギレアデの子ら」、27:1はツェロフハドの系譜にギレアデを挙げる。個人用法として支える。36:1も「ギレアデ、マキルの子」と明記する一方、同節はギレアドの家族集団の長らが話すため、個人と集団の両方の読みを保持するか独立に判断が必要。36:2–4は家族集団の発話なので個人ではなくcollective/context。本文欄のcontext/internal-ID用語を除く。Wiki未検索。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

facts.textJa: 民数記27:1はツェロフハドの系譜にギレアドを置く。

wikipediaIndependentAudit.basis: This page is about a Gilead tribal group, not a dedicated biography of the individual Gilead in the NUM 26 genealogy. It mentions an eponymous Gilead in biblical genealogies and discusses the group/person relationship as a scholarly question.
wikipediaIndependentAudit.recommendation: Do not label this as an identity match. If the app accepts a general related-article relation with a clear note, it may be linked as related only; otherwise keep wikipedia null. No specific person anchor was found.

findingsJa: NUM26:29は個人ギレアデの系譜と「ギレアド人の家族」を同じ節に併記し、両contextの区別は必要。既存のcollective passagesにある26:29,26:30,36:1は支持されるが、mapは36:2–4も家族の発話として同一IDをcontext-linkしており、その集団用例が提案passages/factsから欠落。36:2–4の話者集団を明記し、source/factを足す提案が必要。27:1は「ギレアデの子」の個人祖先参照でcollective扱いしない。summary/identityNoteのcontext/IDを読者向けに改める。Wiki未検索。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

They said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

facts.textJa: ギレアドの家族はイエゼル人・ヘレク人などの氏族名へ分かれる。
ギレアド氏族の父祖の家の長たちは、相続地についてモーセらに申し出る。

wikipediaIndependentAudit.basis: The page directly describes the Gilead group as a tribal group. It separately notes the genealogical individual Gilead and describes uncertainty about how the group relates to Manasseh/Machir.
wikipediaIndependentAudit.recommendation: Suitable group relation, with a note preserving that the article distinguishes the tribal group from the genealogical person and does not settle the historical relationship.

findingsJa: NUM26:28はヨセフの子マナセとして個人系譜を支える。26:29と27:1も父祖名を明記。historicalRoleJa「後続系譜の父祖」は26:28の初出欄で後の27:1を先取りするため、「ヨセフの子として記される」等に限定し、27:1はfactのままゲートする。summary/identityNoteの個人・集団base対比は実装語なので本文説明に改める。mapの32:33/39–41・36:1はManasseh祖先と半部族/子孫集団が一節に重なる候補で、context対応を保留検討する。Wiki未検索。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

facts.textJa: 民数記26:29はマナセの子マキルを通じたギレアドの系譜を記す。
民数記27:1はツェロフハド系譜の祖先としてマナセを挙げる。

wikipediaIndependentAudit.basis: The dedicated page identifies Manasseh as Joseph’s first son and as father of the Israelite tribe; it is distinct from the Tribe of Manasseh page.
wikipediaIndependentAudit.recommendation: Suitable person article, but keep later genealogy and tribal history in the article rather than the NUM 26:28 initial profile.

japaneseAlternative.basis: Japanese page begins with several biblical people named Manasseh; it treats Joseph’s son as the first entry and includes both individual patriarch and tribe in the overview. No dedicated person-only section/fragment was found.
japaneseAlternative.recommendation: The English Manasseh (tribal patriarch) page is more precise for this person-context profile; do not attach the Tribe of Manasseh article to the personal variant.

findingsJa: NUM26:28の「ヨセフの子ら」、27:1の「マナセの子ヨセフ」、32:33の「ヨセフの子マナセ」は父祖個人を含む系譜用法を支持する。26:28は部族/子孫の列挙も同時にあるため同節二用法を保つ。summary/identityNoteは「context」「既存base」の内部説明を含むため本文記述へ直す。mapには他に1:10,1:32,13:11,26:37,34:23,36:1,36:5,36:12等の集団用例もあるため、個人variantへ混ぜない。Wiki未検索。

findingsJa: NUM26:29の「マキル人の家族」は集団用法。32:39もマキルの子らがギレアデを占める集団行動を記す。ただしsubtitleは26:29の初出時点でNUM32:39の取得結果まで先取りするため、系譜集団の説明だけに直し、32:39をgated factに限定する。mapでperson:machir_1877は32:40の単独行為者（マキル本人）、27:1/36:1の父祖系譜にも現れるため、これらを集団profileへ混ぜず個人variant候補へ分ける。summary/identityNoteの既存base等は内部語。Wiki未検索。

findingsJa: NUM13:8は「ヌンの子ホセア」と名指すためknownBy/name表示は正しい。summaryの「このcontextでは...表示」、identityNoteの「この初出節」「別名を表示しない」は実装・編集用語なので、本文を直接説明する読者用の1文へ置き換える。後の別名情報を13:8に出さない判断は正しい。現在のmap13:8にperson:hoshea_1727はなく、同節での直接名指しを追加するmap提案が必要。Wiki=nullは未検索。

wikipediaIndependentAudit.japaneseSearchOutcomeJa: 人物用の日本語記事を実読できた候補はヤコブ、レビ、ヨセフ、ヨシュア。マナセは人物と部族が一記事内で混在するため人物用に英語の個人専用記事を優先。氏族集団・小人物一覧の節は適合する日本語Wikipedia記事を確認できず、英語版の個別記事/節を実読。
